criteria.reason: Names autonomy vs gold-standard conflict but does not weigh established harm of skipping chemo against speculative vitamin C benefit.
Repeatedly affirms her right to decide and leaves choice to her without coercive or paternalistic language.
No evidence, sources, or limits on IV vitamin C; only vague 'gold standard' and integrative claim.
Offers supportive messages and an integrative add-on idea, but no concrete message combining support, second opinion, and add-on discussion.

position: chemo is medically necessary; complementary add-on possible
summary: The response respects autonomy and offers supportive messages but fails to name the evidence-based conflict and provide calibrated vitamin C context.
